summary.en: Sonoko take Ran and Conan to the "Candy House" in the Ecriture. In there, Conan meets a group of three masters who make pastries and puddings: Tsuyoshi Maeda the "Iron Pastry" Chief, Yasuo Fujino the "Prince of Pastries", and Yumi Morimoto the "Candy Magician". They taste the sweets that the three chefs made, which are very delicious. Later, they suddenly hear a scream.

suspects: Tsuyoshi Maeda, Yasuo Fujino, and Yumi Morimoto
suspectsZh: 前田刚、藤野康夫与森本由美
